note: What a server sends to confirm an item left a slot. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: slot
bits.note: Which slot. A client changes nothing from 40 up.

bits.name: notify
bits.note: Set to have a client tell its screens the inventory changed; clear still updates the slot, quietly.

fields.name: left
fields.note: How many are left in the slot; zero empties it, item and charges cleared. Either way a client cancels any spell or action its player had picked.

fields.name: left
fields.note: How many of the item remain in it.

bits.name: tellTheClient
bits.note: Set where the client is to show the change. Set in everything observed.
